method:
Retarget CMU walking to the existing editable 3D proxy for motion reference.

The proxy's art/identity has NOT been approved. It supplies continuous body
volume, actual occlusion and pose guides; it is not a replacement product actor.
purpose: Pose/occlusion and whole-body motion reference for later artwork.
limitations: Proxy character identity and materials are not approved art.
CMU motion is unladen; occupied-arm IK and assumed-mass COM trajectory matching are authored kinematic adaptations, not a dynamics validation.
Support-foot horizontal slip is not corrected by IK.
Finite measured walking segment; starting, turning and stopping are not supplied by this capture.
